title: Target extension and term compatibility
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $n$ sign variables, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction. For every switching trace of $\varphi$ starting from $\rho$, its target restriction extends $\rho$ by preserving every coordinate that $\rho$ fixes, and there is a term of $\varphi$ compatible with $\rho$ that is also compatible with the target restriction.
hypotheses_covered: A disjunctive normal form on those coordinates
A switching trace starting from that restriction
